body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Fuji introduced its new environmentally-friendly batteries 'EnviroMAX' at 2009 CES, which is derived from the basic elements of the Earth. The Fuji EnviroMAX batteries are labeled and packaged with recycled paper and P.E.T. plastic.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
